expectedMissing.showPopup: The asset loader asks which LOD to load through a popup only when it is called without load options. The entry's load() always passes them, and the library has no popup to show.
expectedMissing.import: editor.files.importUrl() loads through the file handler, which the library leaves out. A host loads through the entry's load().
expectedMissing.scene.write: editor.files.export() writes through the file handler, which the library leaves out. The library does not export.
expectedMissing.render.offscreen: editor.viewport.render() captures through src/render.ts, which imports the video encoder. The library does not capture offscreen.
